game.title: Monster Hunter Rise
game.blurb: Action RPG of big monster hunts from Kamura Village, from Capcom, released 2021-03-26 (Nintendo Switch first; PC and other consoles later). RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Kamura Village and the Rampage
chapters.summary: Your first hunts for the village, the Rampage, Magnamalo and the serpents Ibushi and Narwa.

chapters.title: Elgado Outpost and the Kingdom
chapters.summary: The later Master Rank story at Elgado Outpost: Garangolm, Lunagaron, Malzeno, Followers and Support Surveys.

chapters.title: Anomaly Research and Risen Monsters
chapters.summary: Afflicted monsters, Anomaly Quests, the Research Lab, Qurious Crafting and Risen monsters.

chapters.title: Quests, Hunts and Crowns
chapters.summary: Low, high and Master Rank quests, Arena quests, 50 quests in each locale, monster riding, hunt counts and crown sizes.

chapters.title: Exploration and Endemic Life
chapters.summary: Camps, Wiredashes, Great Wirebug points, Spiribugs, Old Messages, fishing, photos and talking to everyone.

chapters.title: Buddies, Palicoes and Palamutes
chapters.summary: Hiring and training Buddies, the Meowcenaries, the Buddy Dojo, Palamute gear and Recon spots.

chapters.title: Gear, Skills and Village Life
chapters.summary: Forging weapons and armour, Switch Skills, Petalaces, decorations, dango, cooking, zenny and Cohoot outfits.

collectibles.name: Apex Shortsword
collectibles.where: Granted for banishing an Apex in the Rampage. Its blade is riddled with battle scars.

collectibles.name: Tempestuous Triumph Scroll
collectibles.where: A hanging scroll from Master Hojo, depicting your victory over Wind Serpent Ibushi.

collectibles.name: Beat-up Construction Kit
collectibles.where: Awarded for unlocking lots of camps. Each of its nicks and grooves tells a story.

collectibles.name: Badge of Excellence
collectibles.where: The mark of a peerless hunter, conferred only to those who have earned a lot of awards.

collectibles.name: Kamura Amulet
collectibles.where: A trinket given to new hunters who have proved themselves capable.

collectibles.name: Ancestral Blade
collectibles.where: A prize for vanquishing Magnamalo. This blade has led Kamura for generations.

collectibles.name: Calamity Conqueror Scroll
collectibles.where: Received upon defeating Ibushi and Narwa. Depicts the two serpents leading the Rampage.

collectibles.name: Fan of Fading Crimson
collectibles.where: A decorative fan awarded to those who vanquished the crimson-glowing threat to the village.

collectibles.name: Fan of Ascendancy
collectibles.where: The mark of a hunter who has attempted some of the toughest quests around—and won.

collectibles.name: Fan of True Ascendancy
collectibles.where: Mark of a hunter who has bested Infernal Springs' most arduous challenges.

collectibles.name: Aspiring Hunter Certificate
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many low rank quests.

collectibles.name: Adept Hunter Certificate
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many high rank quests.

collectibles.name: Rampage Nemesis Certificate
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Rampage quests.

collectibles.name: Arena Fighter Certificate
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Arena quests.

collectibles.name: Spiritwood Necklace
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Shrine Ruins. Made from Spiritwood branches.

collectibles.name: Frozen Lampsquid Earring
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Frost Islands. A relic encased in primeval ice.

collectibles.name: Prismatic Chalice
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Flooded Forest. Was found buried under rubble.

collectibles.name: Silver Cactus Ring
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Sandy Plains. A peculiar silver cactus ring.

collectibles.name: Heliotrope Bracelet
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Lava Caverns. Glitters a red-blue mélange.

collectibles.name: Wreath of Honor
collectibles.where: A wreath received from the villagers as thanks for taking on their many requests.

collectibles.name: Kamura Pinwheel
collectibles.where: Awarded for performing 1000 Wiredashes. Spins smoothly in the wind.

collectibles.name: Shabby Canyne Saddle
collectibles.where: Awarded for riding Canynes many times. Worn in odd places from use on countless voyages.

collectibles.name: Great Wirebug Plate
collectibles.where: Awarded for discovering many Great Wirebug launch points. Sports a nice relevant design.

collectibles.name: Hunting Helpers Plate
collectibles.where: Awarded for gathering 500 Hunting Helpers. Features a beautiful depiction of them.

collectibles.name: Golden Spiribug Plate
collectibles.where: Awarded for gathering 1000 Golden and Gilded Spiribugs. Shines much like they do.

collectibles.name: Antique Bookmark
collectibles.where: Awarded for finding many Old Messages. Adorned with a tasteful pattern.

collectibles.name: Deft-hand Rod
collectibles.where: Awarded for catching many fish. Feels familiar in your hands. One cast, one catch!

collectibles.name: Well-done Grillmeister
collectibles.where: Awarded for cooking a welldone steak 30 times. Good job, and well done!

collectibles.name: Copper Ecologist's Award
collectibles.where: Awarded for photographing many Hunting Helpers. Proof you've expanded your hunter horizons.

collectibles.name: Silver Ecologist's Award
collectibles.where: Awarded by one enthusiastic researcher for photographing many Rare Creature.

collectibles.name: Gold Ecologist's Award
collectibles.where: Awarded for photographing many Endemic Lifeforms. Now you're a Guild-recognized researcher!

collectibles.name: Extravagant Cashbox
collectibles.where: Awarded for earning 1,000,000 zenny. Heavy with impressively intricate goldwork.

collectibles.name: Well-worn Cashbox
collectibles.where: Awarded for accumulating 100,000 Kamura Points. Gleams with polish despite great use.

collectibles.name: Thank-mew Letter
collectibles.where: Awarded for hiring 50 Buddies. We a-purr-eciate your fur-iendly patronage!

collectibles.name: Good Luck Charm
collectibles.where: Proof of having sent the Meowcenaries out on a quest 100 times.

collectibles.name: From Palicoes, with Love
collectibles.where: Awarded for raising various support-type Palicoes to their maximum levels.

collectibles.name: Palamute Gear Tune-up Kit
collectibles.where: Awarded for collecting a lot of Palamute Gear. Daily maintenance is what will make it last!

collectibles.name: Luxury Armor Stand
collectibles.where: Awarded for forging many valuable weapons and armor. Made from premium materials.

collectibles.name: Colorful Armor Stand
collectibles.where: Awarded for forging many a layered armor. Its variegated hues are simply captivating.

collectibles.name: Petalace Arrangement Vase
collectibles.where: Awarded for obtaining many Petalaces. It fills rooms with a delightful floral aroma.

collectibles.name: Master's Black Belt
collectibles.where: Awarded for obtaining many Switch Skills, a feat of both mental and bodily discipline.

collectibles.name: Chef's Trusty Tools
collectibles.where: Awarded for helping Yomogi. You can almost hear the Tea Dealers' chanting when looking at it.

collectibles.name: Sturdy Padlock
collectibles.where: Awarded for collecting many decorations and hanging scrolls. Remember to lock up!

collectibles.name: Cohoots' Dresser
collectibles.where: Awarded to connoisseurs of Cohoot outfits. Perfect for storing your avian apparel.

collectibles.name: Runner's Sandals
collectibles.where: Awarded for talking to many of Kamura's citizens. Feels like walking on a carpet of cloud.

collectibles.name: Dreadnought Destroyer Plaque
collectibles.where: Awarded for hunting 1,000 large monsters.

collectibles.name: Five-in-One Plaque
collectibles.where: Awarded for hunting 5 monsters in 1 Expedition Tour.

collectibles.name: Seasoned Jockey Plaque
collectibles.where: Awarded for riding many different monsters.

collectibles.name: Mini Crown Plaque
collectibles.where: Awarded for registering many miniature crownsized monsters.

collectibles.name: Gold Crown Plaque
collectibles.where: Awarded for registering many gold crown-sized monsters.

collectibles.name: Royal Request for Cooperation
collectibles.where: An official request for Kamura's hunter. Awarded for collaboration with Elgado Outpost.

collectibles.name: Long-Distance Binoculars
collectibles.where: Binoculars giving a clear view of far-off targets. Awarded to staunch investigators.

collectibles.name: Survey Cape
collectibles.where: Protects the wearer from the harshest environments. Awarded for hunting the Garangolm.

collectibles.name: Azure Feather Fountain Pen
collectibles.where: A fountain pen with a blue feather gifted by Fiorayne. Awarded for hunting the Lunagaron.

collectibles.name: Majestic Desk Banner
collectibles.where: A desk flag proving the owner's distinguished service. Awarded for slaying Malzeno.

collectibles.name: Royal Declaration of Gratitude
collectibles.where: An official thank-you letter. For hunters who contributed greatly to the Kingdom's peace.

collectibles.name: Record of Utmost Valor - Master
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Master Rank quests.

collectibles.name: Snowy Cohoot Mini-Pouch
collectibles.where: Awarded for befriending a fledgling Snowy Cohoot from Elgado. Looks tiny, but has a big appetite.

collectibles.name: Record of Utmost Valor - Arena
collectibles.where: A souvenir from the Guild for completing even more Arena quests.

collectibles.name: Painting - Foreign Threads
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing many Follower Quests to mark deep village-Outpost ties.

collectibles.name: Painting - Seicho's Place
collectibles.where: Proof of having completed many Support Surveys. Soar away into a clear blue sky.

collectibles.name: Cups of Friendship
collectibles.where: Awarded for deepening bonds with many Followers. Sharing this cup fosters friendship.

collectibles.name: Painting - Crimson Nightmare
collectibles.where: A depiction of the dreadful Qurio. Awarded for completing numerous Anomaly Quests.

collectibles.name: Sea-Blue Amulet
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Jungle. A talisman to protect you on your travels.

collectibles.name: Copal Brooch
collectibles.where: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Citadel. A charm praying for your good health.

collectibles.name: Beloved Bouquet
collectibles.where: Awarded for fulfilling various requests in Kamura and/or Elgado.

collectibles.name: Familiar Construction Kit
collectibles.where: An easy-to-deploy camping kit. Awarded for unlocking a lot of camps in the Jungle and Citadel.

collectibles.name: Great Wirebug Medal
collectibles.where: Awarded for discovering a lot of Great Wirebug launch points in the Jungle and the Citadel.

collectibles.name: Immaculate Bookmark
collectibles.where: Awarded for discovering a lot of Old Messages in the Jungle and Citadel. An unspoiled antique.

collectibles.name: Natural Picture Frame
collectibles.where: A smart frame awarded for photographing many creatures in the Citadel and Jungle.

collectibles.name: Transcender's Red Sash
collectibles.where: Its refinement exceeds human capability. Awarded for obtaining even more Switch Skills.

collectibles.name: Great Helmet
collectibles.where: A pretty great winged helmet. Awarded for forging even more valuable weapons and armor.

collectibles.name: Gorgeous Helm
collectibles.where: A helm with golden hollows and blue wings. Awarded for forging even more valuable layered armor.

collectibles.name: Solid Padlock
collectibles.where: Awarded for collecting even more trinkets and wall hangings. Won't budge, no matter what.

collectibles.name: Maestro's Trusty Tools
collectibles.where: Super popular in the Tea Shop! Awarded for helping make new dango, even in far-off Elgado.

collectibles.name: Secret Honey Jar
collectibles.where: Awarded to dango connoisseurs for using many Hopping Skewers. Add honey to sweeten things up!

collectibles.name: Napping Felyne & Canyne
collectibles.where: Toys of a cuddling Felyne and Canyne. Awarded to avid instructors at the Buddy Dojo.

collectibles.name: Sojourn Necklace
collectibles.where: A necklace that ended up with your Buddy. Awarded for trading with Letters of Introduction.

collectibles.name: Buddy Whistle
collectibles.where: A simple flute with far-reaching tones. Awarded to those who have found a lot of Recon destinations.

collectibles.name: Flaky Canyne Pie
collectibles.where: A tasty treat for hard-working Canynes. Awarded for teaching your Canyne lots of techniques.

collectibles.name: Polychrome Acorn
collectibles.where: A cute and colorful painted acorn. Awarded for having lots of Buddies with outstanding Skill Memory.

collectibles.name: Windbreaker Scarf
collectibles.where: Ignore wind as you whip through the world. Awarded for performing many Switch Skill Swaps.

collectibles.name: Jewelgrass Planter
collectibles.where: Awarded to those who rode various monsters with the power of Morphed Wirebugs.

collectibles.name: Unbreakable Bag
collectibles.where: Wow! A whole bag awarded for obtaining samples of items from all over the place.

collectibles.name: Comfortable Sandals
collectibles.where: Sandals for exploring. Awarded for talking with lots of people in the Outpost.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Bronze Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for hunting 100 large master rank monsters.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Silver Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for hunting 500 large master rank monsters.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Gold Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for hunting 1000 large master rank monsters.

collectibles.name: Miniature Crown Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for registering almost all miniature crown-sized monsters.

collectibles.name: Gold Crown Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for registering almost all gold crown-sized monsters.

collectibles.name: Anomaly Hunt Silver Trophy
collectibles.where: Awarded for slaying your first afflicted monster.

collectibles.name: Anomaly Hunt Gold Trophy
collectibles.where: Awarded for slaying 100 afflicted monsters.

collectibles.name: Anomaly Research Report
collectibles.where: An extremely detailed report, the result of impressive hard work researching the Anomaly.

collectibles.name: Vermilion Amber Essence
collectibles.where: Awarded only to those who have completed tasks designated by the Research Lab to be the most difficult.

collectibles.name: Bahari's Hand-Wound Birdie
collectibles.where: Bahari's handmade toy that walks when wound up. Proves you frequent the Anomaly Lab.

collectibles.name: Smithy's Custom-made Gloves
collectibles.where: Awarded for Augmenting many weapons via Qurious Crafting. Specially developed to handle dangerous afflicted materials.

collectibles.name: Smithy's Tools of the Trade
collectibles.where: Awarded for Augmenting a lot of armor via Qurious Crafting. These tools can work even the most brittle of materials.

collectibles.name: Surmounter’s Slaying Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for slaying your first Risen monster.

collectibles.name: Shining Surmounter’s Shield
collectibles.where: Awarded for slaying 15 Risen monsters.

collectibles.name: Hero's Accolade
collectibles.where: The mark of a great hero, who has acquired a large number of awards.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1446780)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Monster_Hunter_Rise
Fandom (monsterhunter.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://monsterhunter.fandom.com/wiki/Monster_Hunter_Rise
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and "Achievements and trophies" subpages are linked but not written, and only "Controls" (about 2,200 characters) and "Table of Contents" exist, so nothing was used. monsterhunter.fandom.com answers the API, with about 114 linked pages, including "Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak" and many "MHRise:" list pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "snow" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1446780 as "MONSTER HUNTER RISE". None of the 100 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 51 to 100 mention Elgado Outpost, the Kingdom, Master Rank, the Anomaly and Risen monsters; RAWG and Fandom both list "Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak", so these are probably the Sunbreak expansion, but no achievement uses that name, so the chapter is named after Elgado Outpost. Three Elgado-era achievements whose text only says "Outpost" or "far-off Elgado" were placed by name. Ibushi and Narwa are named in the achievement text; the two "Badge of Excellence" and "Hero's Accolade" all-awards goals sit with quests.
